notes.title: RESOURCE RAMPAGE: second free update to ReignMaker
notes.content:
We are thrilled to announce the second free update to ReignMaker:

[h1][u]RESOURCE RAMPAGE[/u][/h1]

In response to feedback from our players, we have significantly redesigned the resource gathering system. The core of the redesign:
[list]
[*] You no longer need to order the buildings to work. They will gather resources automatically. Return periodically to collect resources.
[*] Resource building storage maximum increased by 50%.
[*] You can upgrade resource buildings even while they are gathering.
[*] You can collect resources at any time, not just when it is maxed out.
[/list]

For the sake of comparison:

OLD system:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/FtQcfsJ.jpg[/img]
[olist]
[*] Go to building.
[*] Click one of the (+) buttons to put the building to work generating resources.
[*] Wait for it to be 100% complete.
[*] Return to the building to collect your resources.
[/olist]

NEW system:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/5ELustA.jpg[/img]
[olist]
[*] Go to building.
[*] Click the (Collect) button to collect however much resource has been generated.
[/olist]

Your buildings will constantly generate resources until they reach their storage max. The max is 50% higher than the old system's max queue amount. When you visit one of your resource buildings, it tells you how much is currently stored, how long until full, and you can collect (or even upgrade!) whenever you want. 

Thank you for your great feedback and for enjoying our game. Please join us in the [b][url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/286200/discussions/0/]ReignMaker Community Forums[/url][/b] to discuss the game, plan events and contests, and suggest potential additions or enhancements.

notes.title: Trading Cards in ReignMaker! Play, find, collect them all!
notes.content:
[b]==> Steam Trading Cards are now live for ReignMaker.[/b] 

==> Woo Hoo!

All you have to do to earn them is PLAY! 

We have:
[list]
[*] 6 cards.
[*] 5 emoticons.
[*] 5 backgrounds.
[*] 5 badges.
[*] 1 fancy foil badge.
[/list]
While you play you will randomly find cards. You can only find 3 of the 6 cards, but you can find multiples of those. This allows you to trade with other people to complete your sets.

For more information, check the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/tradingcards/faq/]Steam Trading Cards FAQ[/url].

notes.title: POLICY POPULARITY: First Free Update to ReignMaker
notes.content:
Our first big, free update to ReignMaker: [b]POLICY POPULARITY[/b].

The policy system has turned out to be as popular as we hoped and more than we expected. We have expanded it significantly along with the culture system.

[b][u]POLICY POPULARITY includes:[/b][/u][/b]
[list]
[*] [b]10+ new policies[/b] added.

[*] [b]60+ existing policy decisions enhanced[/b] with new immediate graphical effects. Some are permanent and some are temporary.

[*] [b]80+ existing policy decisions enhanced[/b] with new immediate gameplay effects.

[*] [b]More feedback on the gameplay effects[/b] of various policy choices.

[*] [b]More feedback on cultural changes[/b] to your city.

[*] [b]Enhanced graphical effects[/b] that reflect the cultural transformation of your city.

[*] Various other little tweaks and "quality of life" adjustments throughout the game.
[/list]

Enjoy!
